# SCHOTT optical filter glass: internal transmittance (tau_i) tables as published on SCHOTT's own product pages
#   https://www.schott.com/shop/advanced-optics/en/Matt-Filter-Plates/<GLASS>/c/glass-<GLASS>
# retrieved 2026-10-17. Each block: "## GLASS Pd=<reflection factor> nd=<index> d=<reference thickness mm>",
# then "nm,tau_i" rows from 280 to 1100nm as printed ("<" = "<10^-3"). tools/schott/convert.py turns these into
# external transmittance (tau_i x Pd) and checks each table against CheeseCube312's independent copy of the same
# SCHOTT data (Filter-Plotter-Data) where one exists, so a transcription slip in either source is caught.
